ctx.x: Okay. And he also was tough to do a session with. And he was monstrously tight. Guys who would be hurting and needing an advance, it was tough to get money out of. Except Fats Domino. He, I saw he may have to come up with thousands and thousands of dollars. But he knew what Fats was worth. Sure. And so, I don't think he did it out of the goodness of his heart. But, man, he was tough for guys that, you know... Like I say, you know, I need to pay my rent kind of thing. And in three months, I'm going to get $800 of…
Mm-hmm. Yeah. You said he... You described Lou as a cynic. Well, how do you... Hmm? You said he was a cynic.
